main.description: Get whether the notification server sends push notifications to one of the requesting account's devices.

deviceId.description: The device's identifier for vendor, as sent inside the token of app.bsky.notification.registerPush.

status.description: active: the device is allowed and the server holds a session for the account. expired: the device is allowed but the session can no longer be refreshed, so the account must authorize again. none: the device is not allowed.

accountAuthorized.description: Whether the server holds a usable session for the account, for example because another device is allowed. When true, allowing this device needs no authorization in a browser.
